ValidationRule.description: IM Internal - Will require a Target Prod Deployment Date at Stage 6 Cases and higher. Only fires on Sales Tools Project Cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ($RecordType.Id = '01280000000BWs8') && (ISBLANK(Target_Prod_Deployment_Date__c)) && (ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '6. Business Approved') || ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '7. Assigned to Business Owner for QA') || ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '8. Ready for UAT Deployment') || ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '9. Assigned to IT for QA') || ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '10. Pending Business Approval in UAT') || ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '12. Pending Change Control Approval') || ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '13. Ready for Prod Deployment'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Any case at Development Status 6 or higher must have a Target Prod Deployment Date.
